issues.issue: Should the appellants' new National Documentation Package evidence be admitted under IRPA s.110(4)?
issues.applicant_position: Appellants seek to admit objective NDP evidence supporting their risk as children of an LGBTQ mother.
issues.result_text: The NDP evidence was before the RPD and is not new; it is not admissible and no oral hearing is granted.

issues.issue: Did the RPD err in finding the minor appellants face no forward-looking persecution as children of an LGBTQ mother?
issues.applicant_position: RPD erred by overlooking stigma and ostracism risk to minor children and by ignoring objective evidence of risk to family members.
issues.result_text: Court agrees with the RPD that the minor children's claims are not objectively well founded; no new objective evidence of persecution.
